obs_sha_verification.note: every play96x112/hud/act_hist .npy was re-hashed from disk and compared with shard.json (written by the collector from the stored bytes) and with the calibrated relabel manifest

plan_seed_set.note: D410-S1's plan lists seeds 1000-1019; this merged set is the 8 surviving WP03.1a stage-0 shards (seeds 1-8) plus the 12 newly collected seeds 1000-1011. The 20-seed / 50,000-decision threshold is met, but the seed identifiers are not the planned identifiers; that deviation is recorded here and in S1B.md instead of being silently normalised

provenance.numeric_scope: `validator_passed` / `against_s1` are validate_s1_coverage's verdict on this merged numeric set (decisions/seeds/observations/duplicates/padding only). That is NOT an S1 acceptance: S1_REVIEW.md rejects the merged set as an S1 pass because the 8 WP03.1a seeds (1-8, train) and the 12 new seeds (1000-1011, dev) belong to different split families, so a training corpus built from them would leak dev seeds into training and would not be the planned 20-seed set. `passed` / `s1_accepted` are therefore false and S1 stays NOT passed until WP03.1c re-collects the 12 missing train seeds and an all-train 20-seed set clears the same thresholds.

not_claimed: not a teacher retrain: no model was fitted and nothing was trained in this step
not an S1 pass: the numeric thresholds pass on this merged set, but the plan owner rejected it (S1_REVIEW.md) because train seeds 1-8 and dev seeds 1000-1011 are mixed; D410-S1 stays open
verified_alive is the WP02.4 calibrated model-consistency verdict, not a survival guarantee; unknown rows are never used as negative samples
no synthetic padding and no duplicated decision row: every decision in this audit maps to a stored obs-v3 row on disk

against_s1.note: labels_cover_s1 is the label-side verdict; passed additionally requires observations_present is true and synthetic_padding is false

accepted_reason: the merged set clears every validate_s1_coverage threshold (50,000 decisions / 20 seeds / observations_present / no duplicates / no padding), but 8 of the 20 seeds (1-8) are train seeds and the 12 new seeds (1000-1011) are dev seeds: a training corpus built from both would leak dev seeds into training and would not be the planned 20-seed set. S1_REVIEW.md records the rejection, so this audit is NOT an S1 pass; WP03.1c must collect the 12 missing train seeds (9-20).
remaining_work: collect 12 train seeds (9-20) and merge them with the existing 8 train seeds 1-8 to form an all-train 20-seed S1 corpus (WP03.1c)
keep dev seeds 1000-1011 out of the S1 training corpus (dev/diagnostic use only)
re-run this audit on the all-train merge and add an explicit seed-policy check (20 seeds all train, disjoint from dev/confirm)
